items.title: Introducing presigned URL downloads in the AWS SDK for Java 2.x
items.summary: Until now, the AWS SDK for Java 2.x could generate presigned URLs through S3Presigner but could not consume one to download an object. Developers had to fall back to a low-level HTTP client, forgoing the SDK’s built-in retries, metrics, and checksum validation. Starting with version 2.48.0, you can download Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) […]
